scope: VSR zero-shot train internal grouped train/val/test only; no official VSR dev/test use.
hypothesis: Removing the fixed instruction tokens from prompt pooling will expose enough caption-specific relation signal for a one-query FPGA-compatible scorer.
single_change_from_failed_baseline: Use only the raw caption token span before normalized prompt-row mean pooling; architecture, split, optimizer, seeds, loss, selection rule and gates remain unchanged.
architecture: caption_prompt_mean_vector: select caption token rows by frozen character-offset-derived token spans; normalize each projected 128-d row, average and renormalize to one 128-d query; normalized projected B1 group dot query
wrong_prompt: deterministic next sample with a different source_image_sha256 inside the same split
winner_selection: maximize the minimum image-clustered val 95% CI lower bound among correct-minus-wrong Spearman, NDCG-full and K96 teacher mass; then val NDCG gain over L2; then lower val objective

promotion_gates.prompt_sensitivity: all three image-clustered val 95% CI lower bounds for correct-minus-wrong Spearman, NDCG-full and K96 teacher mass are > 0
promotion_gates.teacher_alignment: val correct-prompt Spearman and NDCG-full both exceed B1 L2
promotion_gates.official_dev: not run unless both internal gates pass

stop_rule: If the strict internal promotion gates fail, do not tune this caption-mean family on VSR dev; stop it and move to an explicit relation/position scorer or reconsider the cut point.

hardware_contract.fixed_layout: 87 real + 9 context, 3x3 anchors, local candidate cap 16
hardware_contract.note: analytic interface contract, not ZCU102 measurement
